notes: NDMEA runs the North Dakota All-State Music Festival, with a dedicated site at ndallstate.org. At time of retrieval that site was still showing the 2026 (2025-26) audition cycle — registration links dated 9/15/2025, a '2026 Manual.pdf', and 2026 conductor bios. The ONLY firmly published 2026-27 item is the festival date itself: March 21-23, 2027 at the Bismarck Event Center. Audition dates, materials, deadlines and fees for the 2027 cycle were not yet posted. Choral ensembles at the festival include an All-State Mixed Choir, an All-State Treble Choir, and an All-State Jazz Choir.

organization.name: North Dakota Music Educators Association
organization.description: NDMEA is North Dakota's state music education association. It administers the annual North Dakota All-State Music Festival, whose rehearsals and concerts are held at the Bismarck Event Center, and maintains ndallstate.org for audition materials, results and festival information.

programs.name: North Dakota All-State Music Festival — All-State Choirs
programs.ensemble_type: mixed chorus, treble chorus, jazz choir
programs.description: NDMEA's All-State choral ensembles (Mixed Choir, Treble Choir and Jazz Choir) rehearse and perform at the North Dakota All-State Music Festival at the Bismarck Event Center. Students are entered by their teacher, who submits a teacher form plus a student form for each auditioning student.

dates.title: North Dakota All-State Music Festival
dates.description: Sunday-Monday-Tuesday. All rehearsals and concerts are held at the Bismarck Event Center.

requirements.title: Teacher-submitted registration
requirements.description: Each teacher must complete a teacher form and a separate student form for each auditioning student; payment is made through the All-State registration portal. Teachers registering 50 or more students may request a shared bulk spreadsheet. (Described on the ndallstate.org auditions page, which was still showing the 2026 cycle at time of retrieval.)
